# Bug report

## Expected and actual behavior
Describe what should happen and what happened instead.

## Reproduction steps and environment
Give the smallest reliable reproduction and relevant project/runtime versions. Sanitize logs; never include secrets or customer data.

## Impact
Who or what is affected? Note scope, severity, and any safe workaround.

## Regression coverage
What test or observable check would prove the bug is fixed?
